hints.title: Alternating Difference Direction
hints.text: A wiggle sequence requires consecutive differences to strictly alternate between positive and negative.

hints.title: Peak and Valley Extreme Tracking
hints.text: Greedily select the extremum of each continuous rise or continuous fall. Consecutive increases should be collapsed into the highest point.

hints.title: Direction Transition Counting
hints.text: Maintain up and down maximum lengths. When nums[i] exceeds nums[i-1], up becomes down + 1; when it is smaller, down becomes up + 1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all subsequences takes O(2^N) exponential time and quadratic DP takes O(N^2) space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Greedy state tracking records up and down transitions with only two scalar variables in O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should understand why collapsing intermediate monotonic points does not compromise optimality.
